names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 1 iunie, «Sfântul Mucenic Valerian».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Ιουνίου, «Άγιοι Ιούστος, Ιουστίνος, Χαρίτων, Χαρίτω η παρθένος, Ευέλπιστος, Ιέραξ, Παίων και Λιβεριανός», with the rank words left off. The page's body adds «Λιβεριανός (κατ' άλλους Βαλλεριανός)», by others Valerianus, which is the name the folder already carries from the Romanian calendar; the alternative is quoted here and not entered as a second Greek form.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 1 iunie — «Sfântul Mucenic Valerian»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Ιούστος, Ιουστίνος, Χαρίτων, Χαρίτω η παρθένος, Ευέλπιστος, Ιέραξ, Παίων και Λιβεριανός»

attestations.note: **This row rests on an identification the page itself makes.** saint.gr's line for 1 Ιουνίου ends with Λιβεριανός and not with a Valerian, and no eighth name on it answers to the folder's; but the body of the page says «Λιβεριανός (κατ' άλλους Βαλλεριανός)» — Liberianus, by others Valerianus — and the folder's Valerian came from doxologia's 1 iunie line for the same company on the same day. So the Greek's Liberianus is this corpus's Valerian, and the Greek form is added as his name rather than a ninth folder being made for him. Without that parenthesis the sweep would have read the Greek line as having one member the corpus lacks and the corpus as having one the Greek lacks, and a duplicate would have followed. The Greek adds the persecution under Marcus Aurelius, the phalanx of Rome, the beheading and Justin the apologist beside them, and four further members drafted in `el-06-01-1`. No year, so no `dates`; no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nestricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Iustin Martirul și Filosoful, altui Mucenic Iustin și celor împreună cu dânșii; the site prints one hymn for both Justins and their companions.

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received the crowns of incorruption from Thee our God; for having Thy strength they overcame the tormentors and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.
